title: Coordinate query probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite type with probability mass function $\pi$, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree with possible error. For each coordinate $i<n$, its query probability is the expectation over the seed drawn from $T$'s seed law of the structural query probability of the selected tree at coordinate $i$, under input law $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$T$ is a randomized decision tree with possible error
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define structural query probability, so its precise meaning cannot be stated here.
